hero.body: Invited clinicians evaluate bilingual AI patient simulations for training. Competency scores are formative — not yet validated for high-stakes credentialing.

features.title: What you can evaluate today
features.subtitle: Demonstrable capabilities in the current Professional Preview build — no unverified claims.

simulations.title: Clinical Simulations
simulations.body: Timed voice or text sessions with fictional patients spanning common psychiatric presentations (catalog varies by deployment).

avatars.title: AI Patient Avatars
avatars.body: Static portraits with voice synthesis (ElevenLabs). Emotional tone is conveyed in speech and dialogue — not animated facial expressions.

feedback.title: Competency-Based Feedback
feedback.body: After each session, an admin-only performance report is generated. Trainees submit expert ratings and CQI feedback; full rubric scores are not shown to therapists by design.

analytics.title: Performance Analytics
analytics.body: Admins monitor Professional Preview metrics and formative Reviewer Analytics indices. Diagnostic-accuracy charts for trainees are not part of this preview.

progress.title: Progress Tracking
progress.body: Adaptive curriculum and competency graph surfaces exist for learners; pathways are best-effort and not claimed as outcome-validated.

bilingual.title: Arabic & English Support
bilingual.body: English and Arabic UI, with natively authored patient personalities (not machine-translated). Locale quality is under expert review.

how.title: How VPsych Works
how.imageAlt: VPsych workflow from session creation to analysis

1.title: Create Session
1.body: Select a clinical persona and start a timed voice assessment session.

2.title: Conduct Therapy
2.body: Engage in natural conversation with the AI patient via voice or text input.

3.title: Session ends · Admin report
3.body: The platform generates an admin-only competency report. Reviewers submit session ratings, CQI issues, and educational opportunity feedback.

1.quote: Competency scores are formative training feedback. Published reliability and validity coefficients are not claimed until clinician-rated calibration is complete.

2.quote: AI patients are synthetic. This is an educational simulator, not a medical device and not clinical decision support for real patients.

3.quote: Expert feedback from psychiatrists, psychologists, residents, supervisors, and educators drives the v1.1 roadmap.

1.a: Realism is under expert evaluation. Patients are fictional standardized simulations; quality varies by disorder package and locale. We do not claim clinical equivalence to human standardized patients.

2.a: Yes. Admin accounts can review performance reports. Therapists keep transcripts and learning surfaces; full reports remain admin-only.

3.a: We do not store real patient information. Simulations use fictional personas. Training session data is handled with security-first defaults.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: VPsych is a clinical training platform that uses fictional patient personas. We do not collect or store real patient health information in simulations.

points.1: Account data (email, display name, role) is used to authenticate learners and administrators.
points.2: Session transcripts and competency scores support training and supervisor review under role-based access control.
points.3: Voice and AI providers process content required to deliver the feature; avoid entering real PHI in practice sessions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body: By using VPsych you agree to use the platform only for authorized clinical education and training purposes.

points.1: Simulated patients are fictional and must not be treated as real clinical records.
points.2: Assessment reports may be restricted to administrators depending on institutional policy.
points.3: You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials and complying with your organization's policies.

clinical.title: Clinical disclaimer
clinical.body: VPsych provides simulated patients for education only. It is not a medical device, does not provide clinical advice, and must not be used for diagnosis or treatment of real patients.

educational.title: Educational disclaimer
educational.body: Competency scores and reports are formative training signals. Institutional credentialing decisions remain the responsibility of the supervising faculty and program.

ai.title: AI disclosure
ai.body: Patient replies and some assessments are generated by artificial intelligence models. Outputs may be imperfect; instructors should review critical evaluations.

onboarding.title: Welcome, {name}
onboarding.body: You are evaluating an AI standardized-patient simulator for psychiatric training. Simulation behaviour is frozen for this preview — your job is honest clinical judgment.
onboarding.hint: Takes about a minute to read. You can dismiss when ready.
onboarding.dismissError: Could not dismiss onboarding. Try again.

1.title: Create or sign in
1.body: Use your invite credentials. New accounts start as therapists.

2.title: Pick a patient
2.body: Start from the library. Sessions hard-expire at 40 minutes.

3.title: Voice or text
3.body: Voice uses mic + TTS. If voice fails, switch to text and note it in CQI.

4.title: End the session
4.body: Ending triggers an admin-only performance report. You will not see full scores.

5.title: Rate & report issues
5.body: On the complete screen, submit Likert ratings, CQI defects, and educational opportunities.

6.title: Stay within limits
6.body: No real PHI. Treat avatars as fictional. Scores are formative, not certification.
